description: This file contains extensions and views related to the onboarding wizard component of an application. It defines UI elements and logic to display and manage the onboarding wizard pages, including error handling, progress indication, and step transitions.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardCardContent
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays the current state of the onboarding wizard, including error messages, progress, current step, or completion message.

methods.name: wizardPage
methods.description: Creates and returns a SwiftUI view representing the onboarding wizard page with title, instructions, and the wizard card content.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the UI layout for the OnboardingWizardCardContent view based on the current wizard state.
